description: Land Acquisition - Arali, Walikamam west D/S Division, Jaffna District - Badubedda, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and the legal process for taking possession of the land. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers related to land acquisition, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core subject matter is land acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
